Title: Edit Space/Content Name
Content: Objective Set up your CLO-SET Space. Edit the name of your Space per your needs. Company/Brand Line/Season Workroom/Assortment Content Details 1. Edit Company/Brand Name Go to Company Setting General You will be able to change the name of the company by simply typing the new name. 2. Edit Line/Season Name Go to Company Setting General You will be able to change the name of the brand by simply typing the new name, you can go to Space and change the season name by simply typing the new name. You can change the name by simply single-click the Space name as well. 3. Edit Workroom/Assortment Name You can change the name of Workroom/Assortment by simply single-click on its name on the Season Page. 4. Edit Content Name Go to Content page and simply type the new Space name in the top left corner of the page. You can change the name by simply double-clicking the Content name as well.
